response.overview: Fajar (Zidny) and Rehan (Dimas) travel to Alas Tejo village to distribute zakat in the village. With limited directional signs, Fajar asks Rehan to read navigation maps toward the village. Rehan, feeling bored, opens a live streaming app instead, causing his phone battery to drain. Fajar and Rehan get lost on their way to the village, forcing them to ask every local resident they encounter. Ultimately, the motorcycle ridden by the two young men breaks down due to overheating, failing their journey to Alas Tejo village
